entries.11b28937afc9b39d: Under the group vision “Connecting regions and the world through reuse” and as growth strategies for fiscal 2026, it states that it will pursue measures in the following areas: the reuse store area, which involves opening stores in shopping malls, diversifying merchandise and store DX; the reuse EC area, which concentrates EC management resources in Yamatoku; the reuse BtoB area, which expands sales of tools such as “TAYS” and franchise outsourcing transactions; the global area, which aims to open physical stores overseas; and the IP business area, which continues to handle products that use IP.

entries.524cfb2764606216: Its strengths are that it integrates the purchase and sale of used goods in its stores and can roll out sales floors carrying both new and used goods across its nationwide store network. Its direct purchases from general customers give it an entry point for sourcing, and its use of in-house tools for trading card appraisal and inventory search in store operations, along with the ability to sell those tools externally, is a feature that goes beyond simple retailing. The EC operations of its subsidiary Yamatoku serve as a sales channel and sourcing entry point separate from its stores.
